variants.title: Oscilloscope: phase of an RC network with a 4.7 nF capacitor
variants.sample: Unknown capacitor from the E6 series (4.7 nF)
variants.unknown: the capacitor, from the phase on the scope
variants.note: 4.7 nF is a standard E6 value; the scope's phase reading gives it back through tan(phi) = 2 pi f R C.

variants.title: Oscilloscope: phase of an RC network with a 47 nF capacitor
variants.sample: Unknown capacitor from the E6 series (47 nF)
variants.unknown: the capacitor, from the phase on the scope
variants.note: A tenfold larger capacitor makes the phase lag set in at a tenth of the frequency.
